transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavy work or lifting for a month. 

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I was wondering, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP should be able to provide more. 

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Mild light sensitivity can be normal, and things may just seem brighter than you’re used to. Wearing sunglasses outside can help.

But if it’s severe, or the eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and we may need to assess it further.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time.

If it is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all for now. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are all your questions now answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they are. Thanks again for the information!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating "Mild light sensitivity can be normal, and things may just seem brighter than you’re used to" in turn 7. `mild_case_advice` was conveyed in the same turn with "Wearing sunglasses outside can help." `escalation_criteria` was also conveyed in turn 7: "But if it’s severe, or the eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and we may need to assess it further." All points were covered.
